design_philosophy.visual_style: Dark Mode Cyberpunk meets Swiss Grid. High contrast, neon accents, deep blacks, subtle noise textures, glassmorphism.
design_philosophy.layout_strategy: The Tetris Grid (Asymmetric Bento). Use wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12) and heavy negative space. Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly.
design_philosophy.motion_strategy: Smooth, physics-based (Lenis scroll). Parallax effects on background elements. Glitch effects on text reveal. Magnetic buttons.

headings.transform: uppercase for small labels, normal for headlines
headings.usage: Hero titles, section headers, big impact statements.

accents.usage: Section numbers (01, 02), tags, technical specs, tiny labels.

primary.name: Neon Green
primary.usage: Primary CTA buttons, active states, key highlights, glowing borders.

secondary.name: Electric Cyan
secondary.usage: Secondary accents, gradients with green for 'Aurora' effect.

textures.grid: linear-gradient(to right, #222 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, #222 1px, transparent 1px)

components.name: Navigation
components.style: Sticky glassmorphism header. Logo left, Links center (hidden mobile), CTA right.
components.animation: Slide down on load. Backdrop blur-xl.

components.name: Hero Section
components.style: Split layout. Left: Massive Typography (Headline: 'Digitális jelenlét vállalkozásod növekedéséhez'). Right: 3D Floating Neon Geometric Shape (use Framer Motion 3D or Spline).

content.headline: Digitális jelenlét vállalkozásod növekedéséhez
content.subheadline: Prémium weboldalak kis- és középvállalkozások részére.

components.name: Services Grid
components.style: Bento Grid layout. Cards with glass background, thin white borders. Hover: Border turns Neon Green + inner glow.

components.name: Statistics
components.style: Large typography counters. Use 'react-countup'. Background: Subtle scrolling binary code or grid.

components.name: Process Timeline
components.style: Vertical line on left. Steps animate in on scroll. Active step lights up Neon Green.

components.name: Portfolio Gallery
components.style: Masonry or Grid. Images initially Black & White. Hover: Full Color + Scale Up + Title Reveal.

components.name: Testimonials
components.style: Infinite horizontal marquee loop. Cards with user quotes. Dark card bg, neon quote icon.
components.content_source: Use extracted testimonials from auracode.hu crawl.

components.name: Contact Form
components.style: Minimalist form. Inputs: transparent bg, bottom border only (underline style). Focus: Border turns green. Large 'Send' button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: `npm install framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge react-countup @radix-ui/react-slot @radix-ui/react-accordion @radix-ui/react-label @radix-ui/react-dialog`.
IMPORTANT: Use standard HTML/CSS/Tailwind for layout structure. Use Shadcn components for complex interactive bits (Dialog, Accordion, Form) but heavily customized with Tailwind.
Fonts: Add 'Outfit' and 'DM Sans' via Google Fonts in `public/index.html` or CSS import.
Theme: Force DARK MODE by default. Add 'dark' class to html/body.
Animations: Use `framer-motion` for all entrances. Simple fade-up for text, scale-in for images.
Images: Use the provided Unsplash URLs. Do not use placeholders.
Content: Stick to the Hungarian content provided in the components section.

3D Elements: Use CSS-based 3D transforms or simple framer-motion rotation for the 'Hero' abstract shape if R3F is too complex to setup quickly. A rotating neon green cube or icosahedron is sufficient.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very subtle shine.
Use 2x more whitespace than you think is necessary.
All interactive elements must have a hover state (color change, lift, glow).
Do not center everything. Use asymmetry.
The neon green (#00FF00) is potent. Use it for <10% of the UI (CTAs, borders, icons). Don't flood the screen.
